crossRefs.note: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and…
For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into…
The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says Yahweh.

translations.web: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him,” says the LORD.
translations.kjv: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: and I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith Jehovah.
